title: No More 20-Second Stock Photo Intro, Straight to Top 3 | vitalii.no
description:
How a daily news video cut its dead-air intro from 20 seconds to almost nothing by opening straight into the real top stories.

The daily digest video used to open with a generic stock photo and an unrelated voiceover for about 20 seconds before it ever showed a real headline. Every single day, viewers watched a slow, content-free intro before getting to anything that had actually been written that day.

A new cold-open scene now opens with a one-line spoken greeting and hard-cuts directly into the actual photos of the top 3 stories of the day, dropping the generic stock image entirely. The cut is timed to the voiceover's word-level timestamps so the photo change lands exactly on the right word. A separate segment-divider scene — a short black transition with a story-count stamp — now marks the gap between segments.

The video now reaches the actual top 3 stories within seconds instead of after a 20-second generic intro, saving roughly 18 seconds of dead air per episode while making each segment transition clearer.
